text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has felt satisfying, but I should not let that satisfaction make me cut gains too early; weigh each stock’s future prospects, not just its gain since purchase.","Losses feel especially painful, and I have tended to avoid admitting mistakes. I should review losing positions objectively and sell when the outlook warrants it rather than anchor to my average cost.","My trades have been frequent and sometimes reversed quickly, such as buying and then selling Stock B. Before trading, I should check whether the decision fits a clear plan and consider the whole portfolio, not each stock as a separate account."]}
